HatchLibrary__Meta.Meta__Description: The hatch pattern library: every pack the Patterns panel offers. Each pack is a folder holding its own HatchPack__Index__.json and its pattern files.
HatchLibrary__Meta.Meta__WhyAnIndex: Nothing lists a directory - not GitHub Pages, not the Flask dev server. A pack folder that is not listed here is invisible to the editor, and a pack listed here that has no index file is skipped quietly rather than breaking the panel. That is what lets an empty placeholder folder sit on disk costing nothing.
HatchLibrary__Meta.Meta__HowToAddAPack: Make the folder, put a HatchPack__Index__.json in it listing its patterns, then add a row below. No code changes.
